name: generators
cmd: set -e; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; TRACK_M_DISPOSABLE_PROFILE=1 bun research/track-m/install-cost-meter.ts /tmp/gen-originals >/tmp/gen-manifest; for mode in generation production; do GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 TRACK_M_GENERATORS_PROFILE=1 TRACK_M_COST_PROFILE=1 taskset -c 0-3 bun research/track-m/profile-production.ts "$mode" replay-input/input.json mldr; done
